name: Wooden Mooncake Mould Workboard
summary: A carved wooden hand mould and its mirrored mooncake impression on a working board.
description: Original Mid-Autumn craft prop inspired by Singapore/Malaysia mooncake moulds. Explore a carved wooden recess, matching raised mirror motif on a separate mooncake, wood workboard, striped cloth and bamboo brush. Static scene, not a vendor replica or production recipe.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Original parameterized workshop meshes and textures authored as geometry, including an asymmetric local-X mirrored relief pair and original studio render. Fixed geometry seed 836.

accuracy_notes: Original craft prop and original crescent/blossom motif; not a replica, recipe or manufacturing/cultural standard. Editable originals use Blender metres and +Z up; glTF uses metres and +Y up.
